decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits very close to the firm's existing pipeline fittings and welding competence, so the firm can readily interpret market feedback and refine it, even though the website only mentions it rather than featuring it.
The ceiling or floor pipe bracket builds directly on the firm's metal fabrication and pipeline component know-how, and its dedicated web page signals commitment, which favours keeping it.
The pipe support bracket draws on existing fabrication, coating and testing knowledge, and its own web page indicates active marketing, so the firm can learn from early results and improve it.
